```{r q1}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb.db")
listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings")
nrow(listings)
nrow(filter(listings$city,"Columbus"))
library(dplyr)

listings %>% 
  filter(city == "Twin Cities") %>% 
  nrow()

DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings")


library(dplyr)

chicago_listings <- listings %>% 
  filter(city == "Chicago") %>% 
  arrange(desc(price))
head(chicago_listings,1)


sum(distinct(chicago_listings$neighbourhood))
n_distinct(chicago_listings$neighbourhood)

sum(count(listings$host_is_superhost,'t'))

sum(listings$host_is_superhost == "t", na.rm = TRUE)
sum(listings$price > 1000)
```
